resources.string: Each song ends before the next one starts
A smooth %1$d-second blend from every song into the next
Pick how long each song blends into the next
DJ-style: reads each song\'s tempo, beats, key, energy and where its voice is, then picks the transition that fits and locks the two on the beat, so two voices never sing over each other
Let ChordWave pick the one that fits each pair, or hear the same one every time
How long the two songs play together. Long blends need two songs that lock on the beat.
How far the slower song may be sped up so its beat lands on the other\'s. Off only locks songs already at one tempo.
Backspins, tape stops, risers and drops when the energy jumps between songs
Both songs play together on every change, even when their beats don\'t line up. Off lets Crossmix drop the next song in at the very end, or just fade.
Let the app turn sideways into its wide layout
Off, the whole app stays upright however you hold your phone. On, it turns with your phone and lays pages out side by side. Still being worked on, so some screens may look off
How YouTube songs find their stream. InnerTubeX tries first, and anything it can\'t play goes to the classic finder, so songs keep playing either way. Classic only skips InnerTubeX. Tap to switch
Send ChordWave\'s YouTube traffic through another server. It helps when YouTube blocks your network, or when YouTube Music isn\'t available where you live.
Songs, videos, downloads and YouTube requests go through it
